name: Liquid Glass Orb
description: A liquid glass orb for AI interfaces, with animated agent states, voice response, customizable glass material, and six color palettes.

controls.name: preset
controls.label: Preset
controls.description: Choose a color palette. Monochrome is the default. Cluster count defaults to 7.2 for Tide and Monochrome, and 3 for all other presets.

controls.name: state
controls.label: State
controls.description: Idle uses the original Fluid Glass distortion. Speaking adds a subtle voice speed boost to those organic folds and gently renews local wrinkles, while the circle pulses. Thinking offers a two-arm spiral, concentric ripples or curved scanning folds across the entire orb, selected with thinkingAnimation. Error holds a stationary cross. Other states use recognizable glass shapes with fixed material settings.

controls.name: animateEntrance
controls.label: Entrance animation
controls.description: Grow from 8% to full size with power4.out over 1.2 seconds once the first frame is ready and visible. Set false to show the orb immediately. Respects reduced motion.

controls.name: thinkingAnimation
controls.label: Thinking animation
controls.description: Glass pattern used during Thinking: a two-arm spiral, concentric ripples, or curved scanning folds. Changes blend smoothly.

controls.name: searchingAnimation
controls.label: Searching animation
controls.description: Glass pattern used during Searching: Lens overlaps power3.out laps, starts picking up speed again at two o'clock before each lap ends with continuous forward motion; Small lens glides continuously along a rounded path with gentle changes in pace. Changes blend smoothly.

controls.name: preserveWhites
controls.label: Preserve whites
controls.description: Keep white and near-white palette areas bright and neutral under the glass. Turn off to restore the previous color treatment.

controls.name: audioLevel
controls.label: Voice level
controls.description: Normalized microphone or agent-output amplitude. Active while listening or speaking.

controls.name: intensity
controls.label: Responsiveness
controls.description: Strength of the voice response in Listening and Speaking. Changes microphone response, voice-driven size and subtle wrinkle renewal without scaling state-icon relief.

controls.name: speed
controls.label: Speed
controls.description: Speed of the flowing colors. Zero holds the current frame.

controls.name: flowType
controls.label: Flow type
controls.description: Choose a seamless morphing cycle (Drift), a circulating vortex, or rolling waves.

controls.name: distortion
controls.label: Distortion
controls.description: Bend the glass surface into flowing folds and organic reliefs. Supports values from 0 to 8.

controls.name: animateDistortion
controls.label: Animated distortion
controls.description: Keep the distortion points moving. Turn off to fix them at their current positions while colors continue flowing.

controls.name: clusterCount
controls.label: Cluster count
controls.description: Density of flowing glass clusters. Defaults to 7.2 for Tide and Monochrome, and 3 for all other presets. Higher values create more, smaller reliefs; zero disables the additional cluster field. Supported range: 0 to 64.

controls.name: clusterIntensity
controls.label: Cluster intensity
controls.description: How strongly the clusters contribute to the glass relief and flowing folds. Zero removes it. Supported range: 0 to 12.

controls.name: clusterSize
controls.label: Cluster size
controls.description: Scale the glass clusters while keeping folds distributed across the surface. Supported range: 0.25 to 32.

controls.name: scale
controls.label: Pattern scale
controls.description: Higher values produce smaller, more numerous color pools.

controls.name: spotSize
controls.label: Spot size
controls.description: Resize color patches within the flow. Higher values make larger patches; pattern scale and distortion stay unchanged.

controls.name: rotation
controls.label: Rotation (deg)
controls.description: Rotate the gradient composition.

controls.name: seed
controls.label: Seed
controls.description: A reproducible variation of the gradient composition.

controls.name: size
controls.label: Size (px)
controls.description: Maximum width for a bounded shape. Background fills its parent container.

controls.name: softness
controls.label: Softness
controls.description: Soften the shoulders of the raised glass surface.

controls.name: relief
controls.label: Relief
controls.description: Height of the glass relief. Zero produces a flat surface; higher values deepen the rounded forms and their reflections.

controls.name: refraction
controls.label: Refraction
controls.description: How strongly the raised glass displaces the flowing colors visible behind it.

controls.name: roughness
controls.label: Roughness
controls.description: Low values create narrow polished reflections. Higher values spread the highlights into a frosted finish.

controls.name: reflection
controls.label: Reflection
controls.description: Strength of the reflected studio lights. One preserves the original glass finish; zero removes reflections without changing the flow.

controls.name: caustics
controls.label: Caustics
controls.description: Add light concentrations transmitted through the relief. Zero keeps the original finish; higher values reveal brighter flowing caustics.

controls.name: dispersion
controls.label: Dispersion
controls.description: Separate refracted red and blue color channels along the glass folds. Zero keeps the original colors.

controls.name: grain
controls.label: Grain amount
controls.description: Strength of the fine grain. Zero removes it completely.

controls.name: grainMode
controls.label: Grain style
controls.description: Select fine motes, larger flecks, rough texture, or monochrome noise.

controls.name: grainSize
controls.label: Grain size (px)
controls.description: Grain size in CSS pixels, consistent across screen densities.

controls.name: colorDistribution
controls.label: Color distribution
controls.description: Left: more color. Right: more light background. Zero uses the default distribution. Uses your Background color.

controls.name: baseColor
controls.label: Base color
controls.description: Color used by the procedural gradient.

controls.name: colorA
controls.label: Primary color
controls.description: Color used by the procedural gradient.

controls.name: colorB
controls.label: Secondary color
controls.description: Color used by the procedural gradient.

controls.name: colorC
controls.label: Accent color
controls.description: Color used by the procedural gradient.
